contexts.text: Working memory maintenance involves theta-gamma phase-amplitude coupling organized in discrete oscillatory bursts .
Attention selectively enhances inter-areal synchronization in gamma band .
Perceptual binding depends on transient phase alignment across visual cortices .
Long-range communication occurs preferentially during coherent states .
The ``communication through coherence'' framework has become central to understanding neural computation.

Recent work argued that living intelligence is an emergent property of high-dimensional, self-sustaining dynamical systems that maintain coherence against decoherence , building on analyses of falsifiability limits in adaptive biological systems and timing inaccessibility in sub-Landauer computation .

We formalize this as the minimum interval between irreversible ``commit'' events: transitions in which distributed dynamics become readable to downstream mechanisms, consistent with the emerging view that perception operates in discrete cycles .
Different measurement schemes (participation ratios, manifold dimension, information-geometric metrics) estimate this property from data .
Quantum speed limit ( MATH ). The Mandelstam-Tamm and Margolus-Levitin bounds establish \[ QSL = [ 2 E ,\; 2 E ] \] For biological temperatures ( MATH ), MATH s.

Signal-to-noise limit ( MATH ). In additive white Gaussian noise with two-sided power spectral density MATH over bandwidth MATH , matched-filter detection achieves MATH , where MATH is signal power and MATH is integration time .
Biological neurons are energetically inefficient: ion-channel computation dissipates MATH MATH times the Landauer floor per degree of freedom .

Coherence time ( MATH ). We model commits as threshold crossings requiring MATH semi-independent modules to achieve simultaneous phase alignment within tolerance MATH , building on the theory of coupled oscillators .

Let MATH denote the inter-module coherence MATH where MATH is the aggregate phase of module MATH . (We reserve MATH for the all-oscillator order parameter, which serves as a diagnostic but does not appear in Eq. .) The von Mises concentration MATH satisfies MATH .
Why von Mises? Given circular symmetry and a fixed mean resultant length MATH , the maximum-entropy distribution on the circle is von Mises .
Under fast mixing relative to the target set size, first-passage times are approximately exponential with mean MATH a form of Kac's recurrence theorem .
This is a standard result in the theory of rare events for Markov chains .
The participation ratio provides an operational estimate: d eff = ( tr \, C) 2 tr (C 2) = ( i i ) 2 i i 2 where MATH are eigenvalues of MATH .
Ephaptic coupling provides one mechanism by which such field structure could modulate spike timing.
Field effects are causally plausible because extracellular electric fields modulate membrane potential, and membrane potential influences spike timing .
The open empirical question is therefore not whether field effects exist, but how much they matter relative to synaptic coupling in a given regime .
Increasing MATH reduces the dimensionality of the relative-phase degrees of freedom , constraining dynamics toward a lower-dimensional phase-synchronized manifold .

Bias without collision. The standard neural oscillation literature treats phase synchrony as a binding mechanism: when phases lock, information from different modules is bound into a unified representation .

One plausible route is through extracellular-field modulation of excitability: oscillatory phase can bias membrane potential via ephaptic effects , so structured inter-module phase offsets may create spatially patterned gain fields in downstream targets even without synchronous firing.
Landauer's principle applies to logically irreversible operations specifically, erasure or overwriting of a discrete state.

This interpretation is consistent with the analysis of timing inaccessibility in continuous biological substrates : systems with continuous state variables can bias future trajectories without crossing a discrete erasure threshold, because intermediate states need not be destroyed.

Code formation the appearance of a finite alphabet of distinguishable outputs from a continuous dynamical system is the emergent property of this dimensional collapse, not an architectural prerequisite for it (see Theorem 2 in for the formal thermodynamic argument).
High-dimensional continuous dynamics avoid this explosion because trajectories in high-dimensional spaces generically do not collide a consequence of concentration of measure .
Landauer's principle requires dissipation of at least MATH J per irreversible bit at biological temperature an energy constraint, not a time constraint.
The Margolus-Levitin theorem and Mandelstam-Tamm relation together establish the quantum speed limit MATH , originating from the energy-time uncertainty relation MATH .
As Bormashenko notes, synthesis of these bounds yields a minimal computation time MATH .
Typical inter-module values: spontaneous cortex MATH 0.4; attention MATH 0.7 .
Coherence MATH MATH reflects attentional engagement .

The exponential dependence on MATH and strong dependence on MATH mean that modest changes in attention state (affecting MATH ) or task complexity (affecting MATH ) can shift binding windows by factors of 2 4, consistent with empirical observations of attention-dependent temporal resolution .
Critically, Stetson et al. showed that objective temporal resolution (tested via a falling LED chronometer) did not improve during free-fall fear only retrospective duration estimates increased.
Alpha oscillations (8 12 Hz) in visual cortex correlate with temporal acuity: individuals with faster alpha perceive time faster .

Prediction: If alpha frequency modulates commit timing, then entraining alpha via transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) should shift perceptual binding windows approximately linearly with frequency change.

Healy et al. found that mass-specific metabolic rate explains substantial variance in CFF across 34 vertebrate species spanning three orders of magnitude in body mass, consistent with the predicted power-limited regime for small, high-metabolism animals.
Mind-wandering and creative insight (high MATH , low MATH ). Default-mode network activity is a canonical example of internally directed baseline brain activity .

Focused attention (moderate MATH , moderate MATH ). In our model, attention increases coherence ( MATH ) and narrows coordination to task-relevant modules ( MATH ) (model parameters motivated by the communication-through-coherence framework ).
Automaticity and skill learning (low MATH , high MATH ). Overlearned motor sequences compress to low-dimensional primitives ( MATH 5) with tight coherence ( MATH ) .

Specifically, if MATH is estimated from the participation ratio of band-limited phase covariance across cortical regions, the prediction is: MATH increases relative to baseline (more independent coherent modes active) Commit rate MATH decreases (longer inter-commit intervals, measurable via EEG microstate duration or phase-locking transient statistics) Reported time dilation magnitude correlates with MATH , not with spectral entropy alone This prediction distinguishes the coherence time framework from the entropic brain hypothesis , which predicts time distortion correlates with entropy generically.
Quantum-like cognition. Recent work has explored connections between oscillatory neural networks and quantum-like cognitive phenomena .
Integrated Information Theory : IIT places integration at the center of conscious-state descriptions.
Free Energy Principle : We add temporal structure.

Communication through coherence (CTC). Fries's influential framework proposes that effective communication between neural populations requires coherence at the appropriate frequency: sending and receiving populations must be phase-aligned for spike-based signals to arrive during windows of maximal excitability.

A prominent view in systems neuroscience holds that high-frequency oscillations (gamma) support high-dimensional computation, while low-frequency oscillations (theta, alpha) provide low-dimensional scaffolding .
The standard frequency-hierarchy view and the present framework make overlapping predictions in many cases.
A related control-theoretic point: Ashby's law of requisite variety implies that a subnetwork constrained to a low-dimensional regime loses the degrees of freedom needed to regulate coupled regions.
Neural dynamics have measurable effective dimensionality. This is standard neuroscience: participation ratios, neural manifold analyses, and related methods quantify MATH from population recordings .

The perturbational complexity index , which measures the effective dimensionality of cortical responses to TMS perturbation, reliably distinguishes conscious from unconscious states in unresponsive patients.
Psychedelics increase neural signal complexity and produce subjectively enriched experience.
These increase MATH by relaxing precision weighting of top-down priors , loosening top-down constraints on dynamics normally suppressed by hierarchical filtering.
DMT produces the largest increases in neural signal complexity of any tested psychedelic and is associated with extreme subjective time dilation.
These likely decrease MATH by driving the cortex into lower-complexity, less integrative states .
Unclocked architectures (biological neural networks, neuromorphic hardware) pay the exponential coordination cost but gain access to genuinely high-dimensional dynamics .

Operating with low coordination depth ( MATH 5), tight coupling ( MATH ), and stereotyped primitives, the cerebellum achieves commit times of 10 20 ms fast enough to override slow cortical dynamics when rapid action is required.
Relation to synchronisation theory. The Kuramoto model and its extensions provide a mature theory of synchronisation onset and order-parameter dynamics.
